items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: So, first man I seen Manny Gabriel, I got mad. Soon, angry, you know, soon I seen him, you know? Because I know it's going to be some more... So, I told him, I said, listen, I wouldn't tell him nothing that day.

ctx.x: I remember you told me once about how they-

Yeah, man, that old boy Manny, or what it was, Manny Gabriel, he come in there, he ogden, he. Poor Joe Nicholas without disturbing him, poor Joe Nicholas. He want to come talk with Joe Nicholas and Joe, with Joe Nicholas. That man could, who? That man should play parade by himself. That's why they call him Wooden Joe. So, he's got about three or four trumpets. He break the line and go up there and tell the fella what then told Joe Nicholas, what he ain't doing. And buoy me up, you know what I mean? So, I told…
You wasn't getting nothing out of that.
